question: Which file extension is commonly associated with MS Word documents?
solution:
The correct answer is __**.doc**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **.doc** and **.docx** are file extensions used for Microsoft Word documents, representing text-based files.
 
• The **.doc** extension was primarily used for Word files created in older versions of Microsoft Word (Word 97-2003).
 
• Microsoft transitioned to the **.docx** format from Word 2007 onwards, which is based on XML and offers better compression, compatibility, and reduced file size.
 
• .doc files can contain rich text formatting, tables, images, and other document elements, making them versatile for professional and personal use.
